replacement_oracle.deterministic_construction: SciPy/HiGHS 1.2 with presolve disabled supplies a hint only. Its rounded solution is returned only if it is integral, satisfies the original captured matrix with zero tolerance violation, and has the CP-SAT-proved objective.
replacement_oracle.failure_rule: Any non-OPTIMAL status, unequal bound, nonintegral/nonoptimal hint, DP mismatch, patch mismatch, or decoder failure stops the whole confirmatory run.
replacement_oracle.hint_evidence_boundary: The HiGHS hint supplies no lower bound and cannot establish optimality.
replacement_oracle.integer_translation: All [0,1] parse, pattern, q, and varint-state variables are Boolean; all objective, matrix, and finite-bound coefficients must be exact integers.
replacement_oracle.model_generator: the frozen optimizer builds the same fixed-q and global-q sparse 0/1 model
replacement_oracle.output_isolation: all replacement certificates live under benchmark_artifacts_cpsat
replacement_oracle.proof_acceptance: CP-SAT status OPTIMAL and integer objective equals integer best bound.
